title: Citation management in LaTeX
text: Recently I have been writing my first manuscript in LaTeX, and the time has come that I need to insert all the relevant papers I have been hoarding in Zotero to the .tex file. I thought it would just be as simple as exporting a .bib file from Zotero and placing it in the manuscript folder. But boy, was I wrong. The default .bib file comes with many unnecessary fields, e.g. abstract, file path, etc, and it didn’t seem to give me an option in Zotero to unselect them when exporting. After a fair bit of confusion and digging around, I figured it would be worth documenting what I learned.

title: Wenxuan Jiang
text:
Statistics PhD Student | Computational Statistics & Probabilistic Machine Learning
Hi! I am a PhD student in the Department of Statistics at Penn State, advised by Prof. Murali Haran. I expect to complete my PhD in May 2028.
My research develops computational statistics and probabilistic machine learning methods for complex stochastic models with intractable likelihoods. I use simulations and neural networks to estimate model parameters and quantify uncertainty, with applications to infectious disease models. I am broadly interested in simulation-based inference, statistical computing, and intractable likelihood problems.
Before Penn State, I earned my bachelor’s degree in Mathematics from UT Austin, where I was mentored by Dhivya Arassapan and Dr. Jeanne Kowalski.
